reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Malaria Control Program in PNG: achieving a substantial and sustained reduction in the malaria burden - Papua New Guinea (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Papua New Guinea, Malaria, The Rotary Club of Port Moresby Inc. (RAM)This program has the following goals: To accelerate the reduction of the malaria burden in PNG so that, by 2020, the annual malaria incidence rate is reduced by half (50%) relative to the 2014 baseline (reduce Annual Parasite Incidence to 24/1,000 by 2020). The objectives of this program are: Maintain universal coverage and increase utilisation of long-lasting insecticide treated bednets (LLINs) and increase the utilization of appropriate malaria prevention measures. Increase the utilisation of other appropriate malaria prevention and vector control methods at national and community level. Maximize access to and utilization of quality assured early diagnosis and appropriate treatment for malaria (EDAT).. Improve malaria surveillance and outbreak response. Develop, strengthen and align Partnerships for key malaria interventions. Maximize utilization of prevention and EDAT for malaria through implementation of a comprehensive ACSM effort. Strengthen Malaria Program management and M&E at all levels with District level as the priority. Explore and support initiatives for elimination feasibility in targeted enclaves

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for PNG-M-RAMP02
Malaria parasite prevalence: Proportion of children aged 6-59 months with malaria infection
In-patient malaria deaths: rate per 100,000 persons per year
All-cause under-5 mortality rate per 1000 live births
Malaria test positivity rate
Confirmed malaria cases (microscopy or RDT): rate per 1000 persons per year
Reported malaria cases (presumed and confirmed)
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for PNG-M-RAMP02
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to targeted risk groups through continuous distribution
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test in the community
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Proportion of facility reports received over the reports expected during the reporting period
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to at-risk populations through mass campaigns
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at public sector health facilities
Proportion of malaria cases (presumed and confirmed) that received first line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment in the community
Outcome indicators targets and results for PNG-M-RAMP02
Proportion of population that slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of children under five years old who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of pregnant women who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of households with at least one insecticide-treated net for every two people
Proportion of population with access to an ITN within their household
Percentage of existing ITNs used the previous night
Proportion of malaria cases (presumed and confirmed) that received first line antimalarial treatment at private sector sites
